subject: Request: Executive sanction for 30% hosted API rate (MediQuant)
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@mediquant.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal and usage forecast

Kimberly — thanks for the detailed proposal and the traffic forecast. We ran the numbers with our finance team and this looks promising. Two asks before we can push to procurement: 1) Can you confirm a committed rate for the first 12 months if we hit the volume in the attached forecast? 2) We need pricing at a single blended unit rate — our procurement wants a simple number they can include in the PO.

Our target is a blended rate reduction from your list price of ~30% to make the economics work for our pilot and expected Q3 ramp. Is that something Redwood can underwrite for a 12-month committed volume?

Appreciate a candid answer — procurement is waiting.

Best,
Ayesha
Head of Platform Partnerships
MediQuant Labs

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@mediquant.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal and usage forecast

Ayesha — thanks for the clarity and for sharing the forecast. Short answer: we can get close, but anything >20% requires executive signoff because it materially changes our unit economics and capacity commitment.

What I can commit to before escalation:
- 12-month term, committed minimum of 60M tokens/month in months 3-12 (ramp schedule in the forecast).
- Single blended unit rate option (I attached a simple pricing matrix).
- Draft MSA with standard hosted API terms — we can accept your requested data residency and SOC 2 attestation clauses.

If you confirm you want us to pursue a 30% blended concession, I'll escalate internally and request executive sanction. Can you also confirm whether MediQuant will sign a 12-month PO and agree to quarterly usage reviews? That will help our finance/ops underwrite the concession.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Draft_MSA_redlines.pdf (summary of negotiated items)

From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@mediquant.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal and usage forecast

Kimberly — confirmed: 12-month PO on signing, quarterly usage reviews, and the minimums you outlined. We can also commit to a 2-week trial in a dedicated region to validate latency. Please escalate; procurement will move fast if we get an approval memo.

Thanks,
Ayesha

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: Request: Executive sanction for 30% hosted API rate (MediQuant) — need decision

Ben / Tessa — forwarding the ask from MediQuant. TL;DR: they want a blended 30% reduction off list for a 12-month committed flow (60M tokens/mo on ramp). This is a strategic customer for us in medical imaging; win could unlock three references in Q4 and a marketplace pilot.

Why I recommend escalation:
- Economics: at 30% the unit margin is ~35% lower vs standard high-volume tiers (finance modeled this).
- Ops risk: initial ramp concentrated in one region — ops needs to pre-warm capacity.
- Upside: strong reference + marketplace momentum + potential FY27 expansion.

Attachments: MediQuant_Monthly_Forecast.xlsx (forecast, expected token counts); Draft_MSA_redlines.pdf

Requested approval: executive sanction to offer up to 30% off hosted API list as a blended unit rate for 12 months, conditioned on the committed minimums and a 30-day performance review. If we need to set additional safeguards (e.g., auto-reprice below usage floors), I can add them.

Can you weigh in today? Procurement is waiting and they want paperwork this week.

—Kimberly

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: Request: Executive sanction for 30% hosted API rate (MediQuant) — need decision

Kimberly — thanks for the summary and the modelling. I ran the numbers with finance and ops. Short version: I support advancing to exec for temporary sanction with the following guardrails: 1) 12-month committed volume with clawback if realized usage < 70% of committed for two consecutive quarters; 2) automatic reprice to standard tier if monthly usage drops below 30M tokens; 3) include a one-time implementation credit (up to $15k) instead of ongoing credits.

Please draft an approval memo to the C-suite that includes the forecast, the guardrails, and the reference impact. I can present it in the afternoon exec sync if you get it to me by 2pm PT.

Ben
Head of Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FWD: Request: Executive sanction for 30% hosted API rate (MediQuant) — decision

Team — after brief discussion with the exec committee this afternoon, we will approve a one-time 30% blended concession for MediQuant Labs under these explicit conditions: 

1) Signed 12-month PO on or before 2026-03-19 with the committed minimums (ramp schedule attached).
2) Guardrails per Ben's note (clawback at <70% realized, auto-reprice <30M).
3) Implementation credit capped at $15k; no additional ongoing credits.
4) The pricing is a one-time introductory concession; any renewal will be evaluated against realized usage and product fit.

Kimberly — please send the approval memo and the amended pricing appendix to procurement and copy legal. Include the HubSpot deal link and ask MediQuant to sign the PO by 3/19 to lock the concession. I'll loop in finance to queue the billing code.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
